role: source finite input and output alphabets
notes: String alphabets, not sequent contexts.

role: source encoded string length
notes: Locally typed string measure; not set cardinality or proof-line count.

role: explicit paired conclusion and certificate code
notes: Both fields are present in the proof-map input; no output enumeration is required.

role: target string language for an abstract proof system
notes: The empty language has no total surjection from all strings.

role: source total polynomial-time proof maps
notes: Common target language is required for their simulation comparison.

role: polynomial-time certificate verification relation
notes: Range is existential in the certificate; the conclusion is explicit in its paired proof code.

role: paired-code proof map constructed from a verifier
notes: Returns stored conclusion or the fixed default.

role: fixed default member of a nonempty target language
notes: Invalid proof strings are handled without leaving the target range.

role: one total polynomial-time proof translation
notes: Identity holds on valid and invalid source codes.

role: minimum encoded f-proof length of a target string
notes: An existential length comparison does not supply a translation algorithm.

role: source count of atom and nullary-connective occurrences
notes: Counts occurrences rather than distinct atoms; excludes unary constructors and identifier bit lengths.

role: all constructor nodes in a formula parse tree
notes: Explicit measure for complete defining sets and unary-chain overhead.

role: source derivation line count
notes: A reusable sequence does not duplicate a line when it is referenced twice.

role: maximum source atom-occurrence count of a derivation line
notes: Not maximum encoded bit width when unary strings or long atom identifiers occur.

role: fixed finite adequate connective bases
notes: Arities at most two; source comparisons distinguish same and different formula languages.

role: source implicationally complete finite Frege systems
notes: Rules are sound formula schemata and use simultaneous substitution.

role: fixed schematic calculus rule
notes: Rule template rather than the separately scoped verifier relation.

role: source ordered-context natural-deduction system
notes: Proofs are reusable sequences of line records.

role: source natural-deduction line record
notes: A finite ordered hypothesis sequence paired with its formula conclusion.

role: left and right associated formula representations of an ND line
notes: Star is a source representation mark here, not relation closure.

role: extension and theorem-only substitution versions of a Frege system
notes: Extension variables occur in neither hypotheses nor final conclusion; substitution proofs have no hypotheses.

role: proxy atoms associated to syntactic formula records
notes: Identity on atomic records; fresh identifiers are allocated without storing an expanded formula in every name.

role: source defining set evaluated in the target connective basis
notes: One finite gate equation per distinct nonatomic subformula record.

role: nondecreasing proof-line length bound
notes: Argument counts full formula constructors; at least the identity bound.

role: prefix maximum of an arbitrary natural-number length bound
notes: Makes monotonicity explicit without changing polynomial boundedness.

role: left-associated conjunction of the first k extension declarations
notes: Shared guard for theorem-only reverse-order pruning.

role: source n-pigeon and n-minus-one-hole clause family and its tautology
notes: No functionality clauses; the source index shift relative to the existing CNF family is explicit.

role: source smaller-pigeonhole substitution formula
notes: Old direct hole or last-hole transfer through the last pigeon.

role: source fresh stage-k pigeonhole proxy atom
notes: Definitions depend only on the preceding stage; unshared expansion has three branches per level.

role: hole-one and hole-two atoms in the worked three-pigeon refutation
notes: Aliases for P-i-one and P-i-two only in the complete finite example.

role: simultaneous source formula substitutions
notes: Source substitutions and their composition; these are functions on formulas, not sentence metavariables.
